==================================================
Recover declarations after an incomplete generic header
==================================================

class C implements A, number<B;
export function f() {}
const sentinel = 1;

---

(program
  (ERROR
    (identifier)
    (entry (type (type_identifier (identifier))))
    (type_identifier (identifier))
    (type_identifier (identifier)))
  (export_statement (function_declaration (identifier) (block)))
  (lexical_declaration (identifier) (number)))
